title: My Son Forged A Deed, Bulldozed My Cottage, Sent Me $5K. So I Took The Mini Golf Course.
description: My son forged a deed, bulldozed the cottage he promised me, then sold the course for $800K and mailed me a $5,000 check. I found the original agreement in my late husband’s toolbox, proved the forgery, and the court gave me the entire property. Now every hole at Putt It Right Mini Golf features a mechanical figure of him clutching a forged deed, and he spends weekends collecting golf balls in a striped jumpsuit. #ProRevenge #FamilyBetrayal #MiniGolfJustice
thumb_text: HE FORGED MY DEED NOW HE COLLECTS GOLF BALLS
pinned_comment: If your son forged a deed, bulldozed your cottage, and sent you a $5,000 check after an $800,000 sale, what would you do? Share your story in the comments.
